description: The Oracle Solaris Kernel Cryptographic Framework will provide cryptographic functionality to any number of third-party cryptographic consumers that operate within the Oracle Solaris Operating System kernel. This hardware RNG is an implementation embedded in the Oracle T4 & T5 processors.
